title: Choosing an umbrella locker
passage:
Which locker should I use for the wet umbrella?
A. I brought my umbrella yesterday.
B. The one with the tray underneath.
C. The front entrance is still unlocked.
passageZh:
濕雨傘我應該放到哪一個置物櫃？
A. 我昨天有帶雨傘。
B. 下方有托盤的那一個。
C. 正門還沒上鎖。
